author: Satoshi Nakamura
verification_scope: Latest isolated pytest run plus previously recorded deterministic delivery, live Google read and one-request OpenAI evidence; no paid API call was made for document preparation.

automated_tests.interpretation: Latest automated suite; no live API test is claimed. Mocked and synthetic integration results are distinct from the separately recorded paid API verification.
automated_tests.credential_isolation: tests/conftest.py disables dotenv loading and removes inherited OpenAI settings within each test process only

credentialed_google_read.scope: Sheets read-only OAuth; app restricts reads to its fixed sheet and range
credentialed_google_read.connection_script_result: Exited successfully and read ten request rows
credentialed_google_read.running_app_result: Refresh Google Sheets displayed ten requests

credentialed_openai_integration.source: Synthetic inputs/backlog_demo.json, not a live Google Sheets read.

limits_of_the_evidence: Six closely related delivery cases, three synthetic attacks and one clarification case concern one synthetic revenue repository.
The deterministic sample evaluation is regression evidence, not live model accuracy.
The one live OpenAI case establishes a successful integration example, not general reliability or repeatability.
The Google read and live OpenAI example were verified separately; this evidence does not assert a single recorded combined live Google-to-OpenAI-to-approval run.
The business-impact/change-volume ranking has no independently labeled accuracy benchmark.
Safety patterns and bounded validation mitigate risk but do not prove general prompt-injection resistance.
Reviewer names are self-entered, audits are local, and file-level workspace isolation is not an operating-system sandbox.
Automated delivery covers named-status exclusion from one existing revenue metric; broad new dashboards and data sources require scope review.
The BI artifact is a versioned YAML definition, not an automatically deployed BI dashboard.
